draw_pile.note: Shuffled draw pile. Server reshuffles discard pile into draw pile when exhausted.

discard_pile.note: Discard pile. Top card determines what can be played next.

hand.note: Player hand. Starts with 7 cards. Theoretical max is entire deck.

card.note: 108 cards: 4 colors x (one 0 + two each of 1-9, Skip, Reverse, Draw Two) = 100 colored cards + 4 Wild + 4 Wild Draw Four = 108.

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Shuffle deck, deal 7 cards to each player, flip top card to start discard pile. If flipped card is Wild Draw Four, reshuffle and reflip.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Active player plays a matching card from hand to discard pile, or draws one card from draw pile. If drawn card is playable, player may play it immediately.

match_play.definition: A card may be played if it matches the top discard by color, value, or is a Wild card
constraints: played card color matches top discard color
OR played card value matches top discard value
OR played card color is wild

draw_if_unable.definition: If no playable card in hand, draw one card from draw pile
draw_if_unable.constraint: no card in hand matches top discard by color or value and no wild cards in hand

play_after_draw.definition: After drawing, the drawn card may be played immediately if it is a legal play
play_after_draw.constraint: drawn card matches top discard by color or value, or drawn card is wild

skip.definition: Playing a Skip card causes the next player in turn order to lose their turn

reverse.definition: Playing a Reverse card reverses the direction of play

reverse_two_players.definition: In a two-player game, Reverse acts as a Skip
reverse_two_players.trigger: play_card where value == reverse and player_count == 2

draw_two.definition: Playing a Draw Two card forces the next player to draw 2 cards and lose their turn

wild.definition: Playing a Wild card allows the player to choose the active color
wild.constraint: wild cards may be played on any turn regardless of top discard
wild.effect: player declares new active color (red, yellow, green, or blue)

wild_draw_four.definition: Playing a Wild Draw Four allows the player to choose the active color and forces the next player to draw 4 cards and lose their turn
wild_draw_four.constraint: may only be played if the player has no cards matching the current active color
wild_draw_four.effect: player declares new active color; next_player_in_order.draw(draw_pile, hand, count:4) and next_player_in_order.skip_turn

wild_draw_four_challenge.definition: The targeted player may challenge a Wild Draw Four by asking the server to verify the player had no matching color
wild_draw_four_challenge.effect: if challenge succeeds (player had matching color), player draws 4 instead; if challenge fails, challenger draws 6 total

reshuffle.definition: When the draw pile is empty, the discard pile (except top card) is reshuffled to form a new draw pile
reshuffle.effect: server reshuffles discard_pile (minus top card) into draw_pile

call_uno.definition: A player must call Uno when playing their second-to-last card (going to 1 card). If caught not calling, draw 2 penalty cards.

library.active_color: color of top discard, or declared color if top card is wild
library.playable: card.color == active_color OR card.value == top_discard.value OR card.color == wild
library.card_points: 0-9 face value; skip/reverse/draw_two = 20 each; wild/wild_draw_four = 50 each

end_conditions.condition: draw_pile.count == 0 and no player can play and this player has fewest cards
end_conditions.name: fewest_cards
